TypeLeast：按一下，说话。再按一下，文字写到光标处。

## 本次更新 / What is new

<!-- typeleast-update:zh -->
- 提示词模式一步步引导，并说明每个问题为什么要补。
- Mac：点浮条 ✓ 后文字正常粘贴到光标处。
- Mac：文字粘贴到开始听写时的光标位置。
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

<!-- typeleast-update:en -->
- Prompt mode guides you step by step and says why each question matters.
- Mac: pressing ✓ on the pill pastes at the cursor again.
- Mac: text goes where the cursor was when you started dictating.
<!-- /typeleast-update -->
